name: Mizuho Subaru
source:
Appears 17~ years old.
An angel that appears before the protagonist to warn her that some demons are after her.
He was supposed to return to heaven right away, but because he was worried about the protagonist being attacked he stayed behind to look after her.

He has a kind and angelic personality and he treats everybody fairly.
